# Bounded token and closed-input callback

A public instance method returns void while its invariant token and a
closed-input producer share the same original bounded method formal. Frozen
observers outside the input DEX distinguish token effects, mutable context
snapshots, callback effects, the original bounded cast, provider failures,
partial state, deferred calls and later payload casts. Both source and
dependency modes preserve original metadata and compare 64 JVM cases twice;
Signature-only and independently compiled controls check the proof boundary.
